steps.en: Notices show with key details such as the vehicle number
steps.id: Notice tampil dengan detail utama seperti nomor kendaraan

steps.en: Current suspension type and reason are shown
steps.id: Jenis dan alasan suspension saat ini ditampilkan

steps.en: Reduction details are only visible through the reason code
steps.id: Detail pengurangan hanya terlihat lewat kode alasan
steps.why_en: No column shows the reduced amount or the original amount; only reason RED and current amount appear.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada kolom jumlah pengurangan atau jumlah asli; hanya alasan RED dan jumlah saat ini.

steps.en: A summary list of selected notices is shown before revival
steps.id: Daftar ringkasan notice terpilih ditampilkan sebelum revival
